com.viaoa.uicontroller

Class OAUIController

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.viaoa.hub.HubListenerAdapter
      • com.viaoa.uicontroller.OAUIController
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    HubListener, EventListener
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    OAUICommandController, OAUITypeAheadController

    public abstract class OAUIController
extends HubListenerAdapter
    Base controller class for OA UI components. Implements the HubListeners and provides most of the methods required for creating controller Classes (Model/View/Controller) for UI components.
    See Also:
    abstract method of update UI component., abstract method of update label.

        Create new controller for Hub and Jfc component
        Parameters:

        object - if hub is null, then this object will be put in temp hub and made the AO

      • beforePropertyChange

        public void beforePropertyChange(HubEvent e)
        Description copied from interface: HubListener
        Event sent whenever a property is changed. This includes OAObject or Hub properties.
        OAObject: any object property, changed, editable, new
        Hub: allowDelete, allowNew, allowEdit, eof, bof

        Note: propertyChanges are sent for any changed object, not just the ActiveObject

        Specified by:
        beforePropertyChange in interface HubListener
